Application Data.NAME: Artistic Expressions Gallery
Application Data.MAILING ADDRESS: 123 Art Lane, Suite 200, Los Angeles, CA 90001-1234
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Artistic Expressions Gallery specializes in showcasing and selling a curated collection of contemporary and classic artworks, including paintings, sculptures, and mixed media. In addition to the gallery, we offer a range of high-quality art supplies for both amateur and professional artists, ensuring a complete artistic experience. Our inventory is regularly appraised and maintained under stringent climate control measures to preserve the integrity of the artworks. We also host occasional workshops that emphasize safety and compliance with local regulations. Our commitment to security includes 24/7 surveillance and proper storage protocols for any aerosol products used in our operations.

The estimated cost of the damage is $5,000. The claim was filed with the insurance company, and the status is currently "Pending Review.
